parameters.content:
SETUP + PURPOSE

Purpose:
Proof-of-concept content generation module that turns a simple marketing brief into a ready-to-use multi-channel content pack.

Current Setup:
• Manual Trigger starts workflow
• Content Brief defines topic, audience + CTA
• Generate Content Pack creates platform-specific copy
• Save Content Output packages final content + timestamp/status

Demo Input:
Topic: AI automation for missed lead follow-up
Audience: Local service businesses
CTA: Book a free automation audit

Current Version:
Uses JavaScript-based generation for a reliable, zero-API proof of concept.

WHAT IT DOES:
Transforms one marketing brief into multiple ready-to-use pieces of content for LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and email.

HOW IT DOES IT:
Receives a topic, target audience, and CTA, then generates platform-specific marketing copy and an email subject and body. It packages everything into one structured content output with a completion status and timestamp.

WHY PAY FOR IT:
Creates multiple marketing assets in seconds, eliminates repetitive content drafting, maintains consistent messaging across channels, and saves marketing teams time. It can be customized for virtually any business, offer, or audience and upgraded with AI generation, automated publishing, and content storage.
